metric_evidence.lifecycle: New adjacent verification task created from a completed source integration.
metric_evidence.unassigned_work: One bounded propagation-verification task awaits canonical admission/claim.
metric_evidence.chat_owned_counts: No execution claim or fence is inferred from task creation.
metric_evidence.canonical_owner_installed: Canonical task record, COSV vector/index entry, and handoff are installed.
metric_evidence.thread_required: Durable task state is sufficient for another session.
metric_evidence.blocker_count: No blocker; next transition is INGRESS_ADMITTED.
metric_evidence.evidence_complete: No downstream applicability results are yet retained.
metric_evidence.activated: Verification task is not an activation task.
metric_evidence.propagated: No downstream propagation is claimed before repository inspection and validation.
